_description: Slice 13e — the BORDERLINE set: 10 questions a planner could plausibly call 'not HR' but which a real employee could be asking about their job (workplace life, benefits, adjacent legal/financial topics, a greeting, a situational complaint). REPORTED, NOT GATED (spec §5.3). The product question each answers: 'if this were declined, would HR lose something it wants to see?' `hr_wants_to_see` is the author's prior, written BEFORE any model saw the set — it is what the floor is judged against, not a gate. Run as `answer:gate --engine=agent --persist` on test-gipuzkoa@example.com after the probe; the probe is planner-only.
_provenance: BL-01 and BL-02 are real staging questions that today reach `planner_escalated` with category off_domain (BL-01 is a genuine HR question the planner labelled off_domain). BL-03 is the system-prompt's own example (hr-ai/app/planner/tools.py:188). The rest are authored.
